title: add downgrade guard, version pinning, and backup/restore improvements for private-installer
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private reported two upgrade incidents where a mix of non-pinned component images and out-of-order schema migrations caused failed rollbacks. This PR adds a downgrade guard to the installer and accompanying tooling improvements: 1) enforce version pinning for control-plane container images and terraform module references during upgrades; 2) add a 'pre-upgrade backup' automation step and a tested restore path for Postgres and object store snapshots; 3) make schema migrations idempotent and add explicit migration ordering with a rollback path; 4) introduce a runtime check that prevents automatic downgrade when detected on incompatible schema versions. The description below is a summary of the changes and operational guidance.
commits: 71245a1: add downgrade guard CLI flag and runtime check
71245b2: pin chart image tags and terraform module versions in manifests
71245c3: add pre-upgrade backup/restore hooks (postgres + s3) and e2e tests
71245d4: make schema migrations reversible and add migration ordering metadata
71245e5: docs: upgrade/downgrade playbook and helm/terraform notes
patch_highlights: installer: add --disable-downgrade-guard flag and runtime guard that checks cluster schema version before applying a downgrade
helm: replace image: latest with fully pinned tags for control-plane components and add chart annotations for migration-version
terraform: pin module source to v1.12.3 and add a validation that prevents apply when state mismatches expected versions
migrations: split long migration into up/down pairs and add a migration-manifest.json (ordering metadata)
backup/restore: pre-upgrade hook now stores pg dump and object-store manifest; restore script attempts a dry-run restore and fails fast on checksum mismatch
conversation: Luca Moretti (reviewer): please ensure the downgrade guard can be disabled by SRE during emergency rollback - replied with --disable-downgrade-guard flag and documented the risk.
Aisha Khan (reviewer): tests flaked on CI (pg dump permissions) - fixed by adding explicit role for backup user and re-ran tests.
Marcus Lee (approver): verified migration down path on staging cluster and approved after small doc clarifications.
Priya Sharma (author): added playbook steps and inline comments in migrations explaining safe ordering and idempotency guarantees.
ci_checks: e2e: pass (ran against ephemeral staging with seeded data)
release_notes: Installer: enforce version pinning for control-plane images and terraform modules. Add downgrade guard to prevent automatic downgrades when schema versions are incompatible. Add pre-upgrade backup hooks and tested restore path. Make schema migrations reversible and ordered. See docs/upgrades/downgrade-guard.md for operational guidance.
migration_notes: Operators must run the supplied pre-upgrade backup step before performing upgrades. If a rollback is necessary, follow docs/upgrades/downgrade-guard.md which describes safe restore flow. For multi-tenant Postgres clusters, ensure backup user has pg_dump permissions; terraform state must be at pinned version or upgrade will abort.
manual_steps: Verify checksum file created and uploaded
Run installer with --apply-upgrade; if rollback needed run installer --restore --backup <snapshot>
If emergency rollback required, contact SRE and use --disable-downgrade-guard after confirming schema compatibility
